test_title: PYST 23: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 15 Mar 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86cdc9f061265ecee4376408505537fc7b6cd0710c4d61c6ae911c50427f7a34.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) Star is moved one step upper in every next figure.

2) Arrow is moved one step upper in every next figure.

3) Hexagon is moved one step upper in every next figure.

4) Circle is moved one step upper in every next figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfa6367fe68a5bbbed2ea044d4bd6482292748c62b8b3557cb1a487de39ef3d7.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (1)".**
